name: Ayane-san no Kango Nisshi 2
source:
An erotic life in the hospital with a beautiful and gentle nurse, Ayane.
Play as the protagonist who lives near her and grows to love her. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070573.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
与美丽温柔的护士绫音一起在医院过着色情生活。
扮演住在她附近并逐渐爱上她的主角。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070573.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
